programme.desc: Mark Peterson’s South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: The Journey Within

This is one of the world’s best-kept hunting secrets, and Mark is about to experience it firsthand.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Melissa Bachman has made her name over the last two decades as one of the most dedicated hunters and producers in the outdoor industry. In this episode we’ll tag along with Melissa while she chases big game around the world with her Winchester in hand. First we’ll head to Colorado as Melissa spot and stalks giant mule deer, then we’ll head across the pond to New Zealand to chase mountain ibex and tar, then head back to the states for Montana whitetail at ground level.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Shotgun sports are experiencing unprecedented growth, with competitions across the country gaining popularity as enthusiasts vie to be the best shooters in the world. Every summer, the Amateur Trapshooting Association hosts The Grand American in Sparta, Illinois. This year marks the 125th Anniversary for the largest trap shooting competition in the world. We’ll talk with the people who make this tournament run behind the scenes and explore what makes this tournament such a special event. We’ll also look at the rich history of The Grand. On-site we’ll chat with the curator of the Trapshooting Hall of Fame and look at some of the incredible historical pieces on display in the museum. Additionally, we’ll learn about White Flyer and how the clay manufacturer has made important innovations for the shotgun sports.

programme.desc: We're returning to one of our all-time favorite destinations in Baja, Mexico - Cedros Island, with Jose and Cedros Outdoor Adventures. programme.title: FishON! | Remote Escapes: Pike Frenzy and Hidden Lake Explorations
programme.desc: In the thrilling Season 7 finale, Paul & Perry and the team venture deep into Northern Ontario, using a Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake with high hopes for walleye. The adventure doesn’t end there—a bonus portage into another lake offers a chance to explore uncharted waters. It’s a fitting conclusion to a season filled with the unexpected and unforgettable.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Ghoulz have finished the 1970 Challenger R/T SE. As they take it out for the first test drive in over 15 years, Mark and the team reflect on the trials and challenges throughout the restoration process.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark, Dougie, and Allysa team up to kick things into high-gear around the shop. They begin the restoration of a Challenger T/A, Will paints a 1968 GTX in B7 Blue, Allysa learns how dashes are assembled, and they install the drivetrain for the ultra rare, 1 of 2, 1970 Hemi Convertible Coronet R/T.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark pulls back the curtain on the next four Mopar’s in desperate need of resurrection while also showcasing the fans favorite moments from Seasons 8 and 9.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls are back, and they are ready to get to work! With a call in from the owner of the super rare 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet Hemi Convertible, Mark has to work fast to reach a looming deadline. At the same time, Will primes the body of our 1969 Daytona, bringing it one step closer to being back on the road.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: While Mark is on a road test of the just completed 1968 Charger, its owner surprises the shop by arriving in person! While the owner waits, Will completes the paint on a beautiful 1970 Challenger in B5 blue. Finally, with Mark returned the owner receives his restored Charger and cooks a meal for the Ghouls as thanks!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s time to hit the casino! Mark has been invited to a massive car show at the Little Creek Casino but before he can go there are a few things that need to be finished first. Mark and Doug disassemble the Phoenix ‘Cuda, a car that survived a massive garage fire. At the car show, Allysa and Will interact with fans and find their “pick of the show.”

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark has once again taken Allysa under his wing and is teaching her the finer points of installing a grill and headlights on our 1972 Duster, meanwhile George is in the body shop attaching a tricky quarter panel to a 1969 ‘Cuda which Mark has to check off the list…military style? Finally, the Duster gets it’s drive train and is finally reunited with its engine.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.desc: Nick Rutter showcases the products and process to properly wash your vehicle, from start to finish, starting with the wheels and tires and finishing with cleaning door jambs.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.desc: Nick Rutter, along with special guest Bruno Massel, walks you through step-by-step on how to perform a waterless wash, clay and polish, applying a sealant, and finishing with a topcoat wax on a brand-new car.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: If you want to know what makes a low center of gravity so important on a Jeep, then you won’t want to miss this episode.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Our rock buggy chassis is ready for some major components, we’re going to bolt on some headers, cut holes for gauges, and even make mounts for a fuel cell.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt show you what to look for when repairing body panels on your old truck.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno put an S-10 on bags to give the truck a more improved look with better handling.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: The guys outfit a UTV Chase Truck to make sure their Race UTV can make it to the finish line.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno work on a vintage C-10 with a few modern conveniences.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Don’t miss this episode of Truck U, when Matt and Bruno transform a modern Jeep LJ into a vintage Cj-8 scrambler.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: See what it takes to rebuild a Turbo in a 7.3L Diesel on this episode of Truck U.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle swap meet where there's rusty gold and an old Jeep waiting for him.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: An iconic Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop. Meanwhile, a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions than it answers and the owner needs some help figuring out what to do with it.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free ’55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It’s nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

But there's a twist! Every dish we create has a wild, personified story. Who will create the most hilarious food character? Get ready for epic recipes, crazy characters, and a battle of creativity you won't forget!

programme.title: Geometric Food: No Hands, One Hand and Two Hands Cooking Showdown
programme.desc: It’s time for a crazy food challenge! Watch as we tackle the Geometric Food Challenge, creating perfectly shaped dishes, and then dive into a wild cooking battle: No Hands vs One Hand vs Two Hands! Who will cook the best meal with the least amount of hands? And which geometric creations will taste the best? It's a hilarious and tasty adventure of skill, creativity, and chaos!

programme.title: Giant, Medium or Tiny Food? Gold and Silver Color Showdown!
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate food challenge! We’re creating Giant, Medium and Tiny versions of your favorite foods while battling it out with dazzling gold and silver ingredients! From massive burgers to shimmering silver pizzas, it’s a fun, epic showdown of size and color. Who will win the tastiest, most creative creation? Watch to find out!

programme.title: Ultimate Food Challenge! Bite, Lick, Nothing and One-Color ASMR
programme.desc: Get ready for the most sensory and suspenseful food challenge yet! We're combining two epic games into one. First, the tense "Bite, Lick, or Nothing" challenge will have us on the edge of our seats! Then, we dive into a mesmerizing One-Color Food ASMR battle—will it be a vibrant green feast or a pretty in pink paradise?

programme.title: Extreme Eating Challenges! No Hands and Plate Size Showdown
programme.desc: Get ready for the most hilarious and messy eating challenges ever! We're putting our skills to the test in two crazy battles. First, can we even eat with no hands? Then, we're messing with our minds in a Big Plate and Small Plate illusion challenge! It's a full-on showdown of strategy, silliness, and serious spills. Who will master the one-hand technique? Who will be fooled by the plate size? Watch to find out and get ready to laugh!

programme.title: 3D Pen and Pancake Art Challenge! Best Art Wins $1,000!
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate art showdown! Watch as we go head-to-head in a 3D Pen vs Pancake Art Challenge, where creativity meets deliciousness! Who will create the most mind-blowing masterpiece to win a $1,000 prize? Plus, stick around for some amazing TikTok hacks, viral art tips, and parenting secrets to level up your life!

programme.title: Secret Candy Missions! How to Sneak Candy Everywhere
programme.desc: Got a sweet tooth but stuck in class? We've got you covered!This is your ultimate guide to becoming a candy ninja! Discover the most brilliant and sneaky life hacks to sneak your favorite treats anywhere—especially into school. Learn clever hiding spots, genius disguises, and pro-level strategies to enjoy your candy without getting caught. Master the art of the sweet sneak! Just don't blame us if you get caught...

programme.title: 24 Hours Eating Only One Color Food! Pink World, Bubble Gum Battle and Last-to-stop Color Challenge
programme.desc: Who will survive the longest? Who picks the tastiest meals? And who totally fails? Grab a snack (maybe in YOUR favorite color!) and enjoy the fun!

programme.title: Poor and Rich Art Challenge! Who Is Better? Cool Drawing Hacks And Diy Ideas
programme.desc: Ready for the ultimate creativity showdown? In this video, we're diving into the world of Rich vs. Broke challenges! We'll show you amazing art hacks using expensive supplies versus super cool tricks you can do with everyday stuff you have at home.

programme.title: Crazy Food Challenges! One-color Meal and No-hands Eating!
programme.desc: Get ready for the most hilarious and messy food challenges ever! In this video, we're taking on two epic food battles that will have you laughing out loud!

programme.title: Popular Barbie or Dark Barbie? Rich and Poor Doll Makeover
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate Barbie makeover and school craft showdown! In this fun mash-up, we’re blending Popular Barbie vs Dark Barbie school crafts with the dramatic and creative transformations of Rich vs Poor Barbie dolls!

programme.title: Brilliant Polymer Clay, Nanotape and Cardboard Crafts! Easy DIY Ideas
programme.desc: Get ready to unleash your creativity with the best polymer clay, nanotape, and cardboard crafts! Whether you’re looking for fun DIY projects, cool room decorations, or clever handmade gifts, this video has it all.

programme.title: High School You and Child You! Types Of Students, School Hacks and Funny Relatable Moments
programme.desc: Get ready for the funniest school mash-up ever! In this mega-compilation, we’re diving into High School You or Child You, exploring all the Types of Students in Class, and testing out some unbelievable DIY school hacks every parent and student will love!

programme.title: Parenting Hacks for School! Crafty Parents’ Ultimate Art and School Guide
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate guide for creative, crafty, and clever parents! This mega mash-up brings together the best school parenting hacks and the ultimate art-parenting guide to make school life easier, smarter, and way more fun.

programme.title: How to Sneak Candy Into Class! Sneaking Food from Parents and Teachers
programme.desc: Get ready for the funniest and most creative food sneaking hacks ever! This mega mash-up combines the best tricks from How to Sneak Candy Into Class and Sneaking Food from Parents & Teachers — all packed with clever ideas, hilarious fails, and unexpected surprises.

programme.title: Unicorn Magic! Makeover Kit Glow-Up and How to Romanticize School
programme.desc: Transform your school days with a burst of magic, color, and aesthetic vibes! This mash-up combines the magical makeover journey of Sprunki Blue and Pinky turning into Unicorn-style icons with a guide on how to romanticize school and make every day feel special.

programme.title: DIY Stress-Relieving Fidget Toys for School! Easy Paper Crafts and Classroom Fun
programme.desc: Get ready to craft your way to a calmer, more creative school day! This mash-up combines the coolest DIY stress-relieving fidget toys with super easy paper crafts anyone can make. Perfect for school, home, or whenever you need a little creative break!

programme.title: Fun and Easy School Hacks for Every Student
programme.desc: Struggling with school? These fun and easy life hacks will change your student life! Learn how to organize your backpack in seconds, create a study schedule that actually works, and make boring supplies exciting. We show you simple DIY solutions for better note-taking and memory tricks for acing your tests. Save time, reduce stress, and make school more enjoyable with these genius tips. Perfect for students of all ages looking to work smarter, not harder.

programme.title: Easy School Hacks And Rainbow Art Ideas: Fun DIY Crafts!
programme.desc: Discover the coolest school hacks and colorful rainbow crafts in this fun creative compilation! Perfect for students looking for organization tips and artistic inspiration.

programme.title: Magical Doll Makeover: Hello Kitty, Kuromi And Barbie Transformations!
programme.desc: Watch your favorite dolls get amazing makeovers! Hello Kitty and Kuromi get stylish new looks, and Barbie becomes a magical mermaid in this fun DIY transformation story. Perfect for doll lovers and craft fans of all ages!

programme.title: Grandma And Me: Kitchen Gadgets and Parenting Hacks
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate generational cooking showdown! Watch as Grandma's classic, time-tested techniques go head-to-head with modern kitchen gadgets and clever parenting hacks. Who will win? The wisdom of tradition or the speed of innovation?

programme.title: Viral DIY Fidget Toys: Cheap And Expensive Creations!
programme.desc: Dive into the world of satisfying DIY fidget toys! Watch as we create stunning epoxy resin and nano tape creations, comparing budget-friendly vs premium results. Learn to make your own trendy accessories while enjoying fun stories behind each design. Perfect for stress relief and creative fun!

programme.title: Rich and Poor Parenting Hacks: Must-Have Gadgets and DIY Tips!
programme.desc: Who says you need to spend big to be a great parent? Watch as we compare rich vs poor parenting hacks, from high-end gadgets to clever DIY solutions that save money and time! Whether you’re splurging or saving, you’ll find tons of tips to make your life easier and your kids happier!

programme.title: Epic Food Challenge Showdown! Funny Eating And ASMR Battles
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate food challenge fun! Watch as we take on crazy eating challenges — from No Hands vs One Hand vs Two Hands to Blue vs Pink ASMR battles! It’s boys vs girls, creativity vs chaos, and laughter all the way! Who will win the ultimate food showdown?

programme.title: 3-Way Cooking Showdown: Me, Grandma and Pro
programme.desc: Get ready for the most EPIC and hilarious cooking battle ever! Who will be crowned the kitchen champion? In this wild 3-way showdown, we're pitting three completely different chefs against each other!

programme.title: Me and Grandma 100 Layers Food Challenge! Broke and Rich Cooking Battle
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate kitchen showdown! Watch as I take on Grandma in the 100 Layers Food Challenge — who will make the tastiest tower of deliciousness? From broke vs rich food hacks to crazy cooking ideas you must try, this fun and epic challenge is packed with laughs, creativity, and mouthwatering moments!

programme.title: Mystery Magic and Drink Roulette! Lucky and Unlucky
programme.desc: Get ready for a challenge where magic and mystery collide!In this epic game, we're mixing mind-blowing magic tricks with a risky mystery drink roulette! Will you get a delicious lucky sip or a gross unlucky one? The magic boxes hold the secret. Watch as we perform incredible illusions and then face the consequences of choosing the wrong box! It's a battle of skill, luck, and survival!

programme.title: Hospital Glam: Rich and Poor Beauty Hacks!
programme.desc: Who says you can't be glam in a hospital gown? We're bringing the ultimate beauty battle to the most unexpected place: the hospital! Watch as we test the most luxurious, expensive beauty products against ingenious, cheap DIY hacks, all from a hospital bed. From 5-star skincare to crafts you can make from the patient menu, these tricks will change your self-care game.

programme.title: Rich Girl’s First Day at a Poor School: Poor, Rich and Giga Rich Students!
programme.desc: When a rich girl steps into a poor school for the first time, her glamorous lifestyle shocks everyone! From luxury gadgets to creative DIY crafts, watch how rich, poor, and giga-rich students face hilarious challenges and surprising twists. Who will win the ultimate school showdown? Find out in this fun and entertaining story full of secrets, style, and school drama!

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Magnolia Park frontman Joshua Roberts joins Joel Madden for a heartfelt conversation about anime, identity, and carving out space in rock music. Joshua reflects on navigating racism in the scene, channeling emotion into art, and leading Magnolia Park’s creative community with resilience and purpose. From social media strategy to self-belief, this episode dives deep into what it means to stay authentic while inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy-winning producer and artist Hit-Boy joins Joel Madden to discuss legacy, therapy, fatherhood, and reclaiming his power after years producing for Jay-Z, Nas, and Travis Scott.

programme.title: I Go To The Rock: The Gospel of Whitney Houston
programme.desc: Whitney Houston's voice is powerful and timeless. Her heart was always in Gospel music. From her first performance to the best-selling Gospel album, The Preacher's Wife.

programme.title: Get Thrashed: Around the World (Bonus Interviews on Thrash Metal)
programme.desc: Bonus footage from Get Thrashed featuring global thrash scenes—from Germany to Brazil—with members of Slayer, Metallica, Slipknot, and Exodus sharing deep-cut bands and era highlights.

programme.title: Fall Out Boy: So Much For (2our) Dust Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: Recorded at the iconic Madison Square Garden, So Much For (2our) Dust captures Fall Out Boy delivering an electrifying performance filled with emotion, energy, and nostalgia. With a setlist that spans their entire career — from early emo anthems to their latest hits — the band’s signature blend of heartfelt lyrics and explosive showmanship takes center stage. Between songs, frontman Pete Wentz shares raw reflections on loss, creativity, and the band’s improbable journey from punk clubs to arena stardom, making this concert a powerful chronicle of endurance and connection.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel speaks with Bebe Rexha about her start in music, self-regulation, mental health, and her album Dirty Blonde.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Taylor Goldsmith, frontman of the acclaimed band Dawes, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation about balancing happiness with ambition, the search for meaning in success, and the band’s latest album, Oh Brother. Goldsmith reflects on songwriting, self-growth, and the wisdom learned through years of making music.

programme.title: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses perform a co-headlining concert live from The Wiltern in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Rascal Flatts: Life Is a Highway Tour: Live from Columbus
programme.desc: Country superstars Rascal Flatts celebrate 25 years of music with a hometown performance in Columbus, Ohio, recorded on their Life Is a Highway Tour. The set features timeless hits like Bless the Broken Road, What Hurts the Most, Mayberry, Fast Cars and Freedom, and Life Is a Highway. It’s an evening filled with nostalgia, gratitude, and classic country harmony.

programme.title: Anthony Green: So Long, Avalon Live In New York
programme.desc: Experience Anthony Green live from the Gramercy Theatre in New York as he celebrates the release of So Long, Avalon. An intimate, high–energy set blends new material with fan favorites, spontaneous crowd moments, and a playful nod to classic “Kokomo.” Green spotlights his touring band — Greg Mervine (drums), Sean Cohen (multi-instrumentalist), Dave Davison, and Keith Goodwin — and shouts out friends Kurt Travis and Geoff Rickly for helping shape a special night. A dynamic performance that captures Green’s voice, humor, and gratitude in a room full of true believers.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Michael Clifford, guitarist and songwriter of 5 Seconds of Summer, joins Joel Madden to talk about fatherhood, the meaning of maturity, and rediscovering the joy of music through his solo debut Side Quest. Clifford reflects on how parenthood reshaped his creativity, working with bandmate Calum Hood, and learning to write from a more grounded, human perspective.

programme.title: Jay Pharoah: Can I Be Me?
programme.desc: Jay Pharoah delivers a stand-up special packed with celebrity impressions and sharp humor, featuring takes on icons like Jay-Z, Barack Obama, and more.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Italian singer, songwriter, and frontman of Måneskin, Damiano David joins Joel Madden to discuss pursuing happiness through creativity, missing home while touring, and his upcoming solo project. He reflects on defining authenticity in pop and rock, staying grounded through fame, and the evolving relationship between art, purpose, and balance.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Producer/guitarist Josh Carter—one half of genre-bending duo Phantogram—joins host Joel Madden to talk about why trying too hard can kill the art, his creative/lifelong bond with bandmate Sarah Barthel, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. From upstate New York origins to Brooklyn and now L.A., Josh digs into collaboration culture, beat-making roots, Big Grams with Big Boi, and the hip-hop influences (Beastie Boys, Wu-Tang, Public Enemy) that shaped his sound—plus a little baseball talk (Mets, Dodgers, Orioles).

programme.title: 311 Day 2024 Live from Las Vegas: Night 2
programme.desc: 311 returns for Night 2 of their 311 Day celebration with a unique 2+ hour set of fan favorites and surprises live from Park MGM in Las Vegas.

programme.title: a-ha: True North
programme.desc: 90km above the Arctic Circle, Norway's very own a-ha recorded their first collection of music since 2015's Cast in Steel. "True North is a letter from a-ha, from the Arctic Circle, a poem from the far north of Norway," says Magne Furuholmen. Accompanied by a film, the conceptual collection combines the band's visions and the talent of Norwegian orchestra, Arctic Philharmonic.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live In Hamburg
programme.desc: Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.
